title: Etale scheme-chart test of a presheaf morphism property
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $E,F:(\mathit{Sch}/S)^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathit{Set}$ be presheaves of sets and let $f:E\to F$ be a natural transformation. Let $P$ be a property of morphisms of schemes in the chosen universe. Define $\operatorname{OnEtaleCharts}(P,f)$ to mean that for every pair of $S$-schemes $U,V$, every pair of representable etale natural transformations $a:h_U\to E$, $b:h_V\to F$ in the scheme-test sense of [def-trf-algebraic-space], and every $S$-morphism $h:U\to V$ satisfying $f\circ a=b\circ h_h$, the underlying scheme morphism $h$ has property $P$. Here $h_T$ is the Yoneda presheaf of an $S$-scheme $T$ and $h_h:h_U\to h_V$ is induced by $h$. Neither $E,F$ nor $f$ is required to be representable; the presheaves are not required to be sheaves or algebraic spaces.
